confirmDescriptions.3d: Sends the standard “3 days before due” rent template for this month. The body shows remaining, not the original amount.
confirmDescriptions.1d: Sends the standard “1 day before due” rent template for this month. The body shows remaining.
confirmDescriptions.0d: Sends the standard “due today” rent reminder. The body shows remaining.
confirmDescriptions.overdue: Sends the notice that this month is overdue (after the due date end in UTC). The body shows remaining.
